supporting_observations.claim: The account leo.martins experienced two failed domain logon attempts (Event ID 4625) originating from an external IP address 203.0.113.250.
A successful logon (Event ID 4624) for leo.martins occurred from the same external IP address 203.0.113.250 shortly after the failures.
The activity is malicious because the organization has no VPN and no approved remote-access services, meaning any external logon from 203.0.113.250 is unauthorized.

claims_not_established: Whether the external IP address 203.0.113.250 belongs to a known adversary or a compromised third-party.
